issues.title: Ganoderma: widespread (PA) vs negligible (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Kema 6.6.2 (9 Jun 2026): a lot of infected palms, particularly block G, mostly upper stem rot, census and deboling advised. Agro 1/2026 4.5.7 (14 May 2026): Ganoderma infection remains negligible. PA Timur also found sporadic infection in P98A1.

issues.title: PA Timur 2024 yield and the 29% gain are wrong
issues.detail: PA Timur 8.1-8.2 says 2025 yield 25.53 t/ha was 29% above 2024 at 19.77 t/ha. Its own 2024 crop of 10,225.67 t on 411.80 ha is 24.83 t/ha, and Agro Table 12 shows 24.83 to 25.53 (+2.8%). The 19.77 and 19.36 t/ha figures do not reconcile to the tonnage.

issues.title: Timur 2021-2024 annual totals misprinted in Agro
issues.detail: Agro Appendix 2a prints annual Timur totals of 8,729.75 (2021), 10,249.06 (2022), 10,164.90 (2023) and 12,249.67 t (2024). The monthly figures sum to 6,708.75, 8,227.06, 8,141.90 and 10,225.67 t. Only 2025 (10,513.05) and 2024 per the PA (10,225.67) are consistent. Printed 2024 total would wrongly show a 14% fall in 2025.

issues.title: Kema area basis: 406.19 ha vs 412.70 ha
issues.detail: PA Kema crop and RM/ha tables use 406.19 ha, giving 26.53 t/ha for 2025 (budget 25.40, 2024 24.50). The area statement and Agro use 412.70 ha, giving 26.12 t/ha (2024: 24.11). Same crop of 10,777.97 t.

issues.title: Weeding: 67-83% done (PA) vs three rounds completed (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Timur 6.3.1: circle spraying 83% (2.3 of 2.8 rounds) and selective 67% to Dec 2025. PA Kema: circle 67% (2 of 3 rounds), selective 99%. Agro 4.4.1 says both divisions completed three rounds of inter-row and circle weeding as budgeted in 2025.

issues.title: Rats: no issue (PA Timur) vs above threshold (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Timur 6.6.1 (10 Jun 2026): all blocks below 10% in 2025, no baiting, no issues. Agro Table 10 (Apr 2026): P02B2 and P02B3 at 11%, baiting started early Apr 2026. Agro 5.6 says rat pressure is high in P06D (Timur) and P08G, yet Table 10 shows P06D at 7-8%.

issues.title: Agro stresses P18H rats, but P18H is 9% in its own table
issues.detail: Agro 6.5 says rat infestation in P18H needs immediate action. Agro Table 10 shows P18H 9% (below 10%) while P08G1 and P08G2 are 12% and P08G3 11%. PA Kema also calls P18 rat infestation extensive but its census shows 7-13% for 2025.

issues.title: Kema roads: unsatisfactory (PA) vs satisfactory (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Kema item 8 and 6.7.2: collection roads unsatisfactory, hilly sections badly damaged, only 344.18 of 2,000 chains graded in 2025 and none to May 2026. Agro 4.1.3: roads generally satisfactory. PA Timur also reports a road cut off by eroded culverts at P03C.

issues.title: Replanting: none planned (PA Timur) vs P98A1 in 2028 (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Timur 2.3 says no replanting plans yet. Agro 2.2-2.3 schedules P98A1 (46.50 ha, Timur B) for 2028 and P98E1/E2 (77.95 ha, Kema) for 2027, with the P98E fertiliser programme already withdrawn.

issues.title: Barn owl occupancy: 80% (PA Timur) vs 61% (Agro)
issues.detail: PA Timur 6.6.2 says occupancy averaged 80% and was acceptable. The same Oct 2025 census in Agro Table 11 gives 22 of 36 boxes = 61% (P03C 29%, P98A1 and P02B3 50%), below threshold.

issues.title: Cost of production basis differs between divisions
issues.detail: PA Timur harvesting RM72/t excludes external transport (section 7 total RM103.83/t less RM31.66 external). PA Kema harvesting RM108.21/t in the cost table does not match its section 7 total of RM76.57/t (which excludes despatch), so it appears to include about RM31/t of despatch. Combined COP mixes the two bases.

issues.title: Timur labour statement does not add up
issues.detail: PA Timur table: harvesters show 17 contract workers but a total of 19 (text 3.1 also says 19); total workers 27 vs 29 required is -2, yet the table prints -5.

issues.title: General charges overspend stated as 312%
issues.detail: PA Timur 5.1 says 312% overspent. Accent Palm actual RM1,194,118.43 vs budget RM382,561.35 is 3.12 times budget (+212%); Promvest RM603,436.05 vs RM97,909.58 is 6.2 times. Combined Timur RM1,797,554.48 vs RM480,470.93 is 3.7 times (+274%). PA says unbudgeted Head Office charges; Pinfosys not implemented, so PA could not verify.

issues.title: Palm thinning totals: 730 vs 1,748
issues.detail: Agro Table 8 rows add to 730 palms (matches text 4.2.4), but the table prints a grand total of 1,748. The Plantation Controller had asked for clarification on thinning in P08.

issues.title: Harvest interval: 12 days (PA) vs 13-17 days (Agro)
issues.detail: Both PAs say interval averaged 12 days (Jun 2026). Agro Tables 6-7 show 13-15 days in Timur and 11-17 days in Kema for Jan-Apr 2026; Kema January rows are 15-17 days against the Agro text of within 15 days.

actions.item: Recruit harvesters: Timur 19 vs 20, Kema 18 vs 20 (Dec 2025)

Complete road grading and collection road repairs before the monsoon; resume suspended grading (diesel)

Ganoderma census and deboling, starting with Kema block G and Timur P98A1
Continue rat census; bait where above 10% (P02B2, P02B3, P08G, P18H)
Clean, repair or replace barn owl boxes in Timur (61% occupancy)
Review circle and selective spraying piece rates (RM19.76-24.71/ha vs usual RM15-20/ha) and chemical usage

Use official area statement, not stand per ha, for spraying programme (Timur)
Update palm census for Kema division and use it for fertiliser budgeting
Supervise palm thinning; SM approval before removal of abnormal palms
Eradicate overgrown VOPs and wild bananas in Kema ravines; charge to selective weeding
Consider digging boundary trenches against elephant intrusion at P18H
Collect all FFB daily; no bunches left overnight along boundaries
Replant P98E1/E2 in 2027 and P98A1 in 2028; withdraw fertiliser once confirmed
Prepare 2027 fertiliser programme after second-half 2026 field inspection; re-sample leaves in 2026
Consider promoting field conductor Azren to at least Junior Assistant (Timur)

kb:
LADANG NUKLIAS 6 (Prosper group). Oil palm estate in two divisions run by Estate Manager En. Yunus Bin Saom, with Visiting Senior Manager En. Mat Zin Bin Mat Akir and Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok (Agro). Timur division = Timur A (Accent Palm Sdn Bhd, 255.46 ha) and Timur B (Promvest Sdn Bhd, 156.34 ha). Kema division = Innomakmur Sdn Bhd (412.70 ha). Sources: (1) PA Report 1/2026 Timur A & B, visit 10 June 2026, review Jan–Dec 2025, PA En. Adnan Bin Mustafa, signed by Boey Chee Weng; (2) PA Report 1/2026 Kema Division, visit 9 June 2026, review Jan–Dec 2025, same authors; (3) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 14 May 2026 (previous visit 18 Nov 2025), by Ghazali Abd Ghani (Junior) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior), crop and weeding data to April 2026. Combined estate figures marked (derived) were added up by the dashboard compiler from the division figures; the reports themselves give no estate-wide totals.

AREA (PA Timur, PA Kema, Agro Table 1). Timur: mature 411.80 ha (98.0%), immature none, housing/road 1.93, ponds/river reserves/steep 6.15, unplantable 1.00, total 420.88 ha. Kema: mature 412.70 ha (98%), unplanted 7.10, compound 0.81, ramp 0.40, total 421.01 ha. Estate planted (derived) 824.50 ha, all mature; Agro: no immature plantings (P18H counted by Agro as young mature). Title area (derived) 841.89 ha.
Blocks Timur A: P02B1 62.00 ha, P02B2 56.85, P06D1 70.99, P06D2 65.62. Timur B: P98A1 46.50 (1998), P02B3 43.43 (2002), P03C 66.41 (2003). Kema: P98E1 53.39 and P98E2 24.56 (1998), P09F1 49.28 and P09F2 89.55 (2009), P08G1 68.58, P08G2 45.83, P08G3 63.09 (2008), P18H 18.41 (2018). All DxP.
Age (Agro 2.5): 41% prime, 44% aging, 15% very old. Replanting (Agro): P98E1/E2 (77.95 ha, 18.88% of Kema) deferred to 2027 and the fertiliser programme for P98E is withdrawn; P98A1 (46.50 ha) planned 2028. PA Timur says no replanting plans yet; PA Kema says P98E replanting postponed.

PALM DENSITY (Agro Table 3; Kema census not yet updated). Palms per ha: Timur A P02B1 130, P02B2 125, P06D1 126, P06D2 132 (32,779 palms, 128/ha); Timur B P98A1 128, P02B3 129, P03C 127 (19,919, 127/ha); Kema P98E1 128, P98E2 112, P09F1 116, P09F2 125, P08G1 130, P08G2 116, P08G3 122, P18H 138 (50,924, 123/ha).

LABOUR (PA Timur, PA Kema, Dec 2025). Timur: harvesters 19 vs 20 required (1:22 ha; one short), manuring workers 2 vs 3, spraying workers 2 vs 3, drivers 2 vs 2, line sweeper 1 vs 0, ramp attendant 1 vs 1; total 27 vs 29 required; worker ratio 1:15 ha. The table lists 17 contract harvesters against a total of 19 and prints a shortfall of -5 where the rows give -2. Kema: harvesters 18 vs 20 (1:23 ha; two short), manuring 2 vs 2, spraying 2 vs 2, drivers 2 vs 2, sweeper 1 vs 1, ramp 1 vs 1; total 26 vs 28; ratio 1:16 ha. PA Kema: recruit more harvesters to cover shortage and be ready for peak crop; Group MD wants ratio 1:22 ha with 18 harvesters on mostly tall prime palms. Staff: Timur Assistant transferred out Sep 2025 with no replacement; PA recommends promoting Field Conductor Mohd Azren to at least Junior Assistant.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA, Jan–Dec 2025). Timur Accent Palm: actual RM1,194,118.43 vs budget RM382,561.35 (management RM698,860.25; labour and amenities RM10,064.49; other RM479,397.36; MSPO RM5,796.33). Timur Promvest: actual RM603,436.05 vs budget RM97,909.58 (management RM396,240.37; labour RM11,233.60; other RM191,020.45; MSPO RM4,941.63). PA states Timur overspent 312% from unbudgeted Head Office items; Pinfosys not implemented. Kema: actual RM1,038,551.86 vs budget RM572,162.19 (management RM704,336.64; labour RM14,733.23; other RM313,669.65; MSPO RM5,812.34), overspent 82%; PA could not comment because Pinfosys is not implemented. Combined (derived) RM2,836,106.34 vs RM1,052,633.12.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA, Jan–Dec 2025, RM). Timur total 716,769.59 vs budget 684,794.32 (+5%, wrong Head Office charging): weeding 80,295.61 (92,655.00); manuring 551,112.57 (509,513.04); pest and disease 880 (6,502.90); drains 0 (19,399.26); roads 37,699.40 (14,160.58); tools 7,180.10 (0); pruning 39,601.91 (42,563.54). Kema total 963,884.47 vs 728,740.23: weeding 107,742.06 (94,219.41); manuring 631,291.02 (545,671.94); pest and disease 31,115.10 (5,809.20); drains 14,555 (16,600); roads 126,260.47 (23,830); supplying 2,000 (none done); pruning 49,920.82 (40,609.68). Kema RM/ha in PA uses 406.19 ha.

WEEDING (PA). Timur circle spraying 956.39 ha (2.3 rounds) = 83% of 1,155.54 ha (2.8 rounds) to Dec 2025, short by Nov–Dec rain; selective 823.60 ha (2 rounds) = 67% of 1,235.40 ha. Estate used stand/ha (1,155.54 ha) instead of area statement (1,235.40 ha); advised to use official ha. CKS circle output 5.1 ha/man-day, RM19.76/ha, RM100.78/day, glyphosate 0.68 l/ha (high). Mist blower selective 5.7 ha/man-day, RM24.71/ha (high; group norm RM17, PA suggests about RM15), RM140.85/day, Garlon 0.83 l/ha (should be 0.5). P98A1 grassy circles, woodies and VOPs. Kema circle 830.79 ha (2 rounds) = 67% of 1,236.98 ha; selective 1,218.57 ha (2.9 rounds) = 99%. CKS output 3.3 ha/man-day, RM24.71/ha (usual RM16–20), RM81.54/day, glyphosate 0.58 l/ha; 9 pumps/man-day vs potential 12; advised CDA or Inter Pump for 5 ha/man-day. Selective 4 ha/man-day, RM98.84/day, Garlon 0.84 l/ha, 10 pumps/day; ravines near drains have overgrown VOPs and wild bananas (P09F1). Agro 4.4: both divisions did three inter-row and three circle rounds in 2025 as budgeted; Apr 2026 first round 100% done everywhere, soft grasses dominant, circles established; two rounds remaining in 2026 (one circle round remaining per Agro 4.4.3 for Timur).

MANURING (PA, Agro). 2025 programme completed 100% in both divisions. Agro Table 4: Timur Mix B 220.00 mt, NK1 195.80, RP 38.80, total 454.60 mt; Kema Mix B 352.80, NK1 66.98, kieserite 1.91, RP 62.67, total 484.36 mt. PA: Timur 27 rounds (100%), Kema 37 rounds (100%). Output 30 bags/man-day both; Timur RM2.30/bag (RM69/day), Kema RM2.50/bag (RM75/day). Agro visit at P02B2: four applicators did 27 bags each, even broadcast. 2026 to Apr (Agro Table 5): Timur Mix A 16.70 of 33.40 mt applied (ongoing), Mix B 39.45 of 78.90, NK1 51.65 of 154.95, NK2 14.65 of 29.30, balance NK1 5.05 mt (101 bags); Kema Mix B 186.10 of 372.20 mt, NK2 23.90 of 47.85, kieserite 6.10 of 30.45, CIRP 0 of 61.95. Agro says rest on schedule. 2026 programme was revised, especially second half, due to fertiliser price rise and limited stock; 2027 programme to be drawn after second-half 2026 inspection. Revised 2026 programme (Agro Appendix 1, kg per palm): P02B1, P02B2, P02B3 NK1 2.50 twice; P06D1, P06D2 Mix B 2.25, Mix A 2.00, Mix B 2.00; P03C Mix A 2.00 three times; P98A1 NK2 2.50 once; P98E withdrawn; P08G and P09F Mix B 2.25, kieserite 0.75, Mix B 2.25, RP 1.50, Mix B 1.50, Mix B 1.50; P18H same with kieserite 0.50. Mix A 45% SOA, 40% MOP, 15% kieserite; Mix B 45% SOA, 40% MOP, 14% kieserite, 1% borate; NK1 50:50 SOA:MOP; NK2 60:40.

PEST AND DISEASE. Rats (PA, Agro): Timur 2025 quarterly census 5–9% (below 10%) so no baiting (PA). Agro Table 10 Apr 2026: Timur P98A1 6%, P02B1 6%, P02B2 11%, P02B3 11%, P03C 0%, P06D1 7%, P06D2 8%; Kema P98E1 0%, P98E2 0%, P09F1 8%, P09F2 9%, P08G1 12%, P08G2 12%, P08G3 11%, P18H 9%. First baiting early April 2026 with second-generation bait, dead rats seen. Agro 5.6 says Feb–Mar 2026 census was high for P06D and P08G. Kema 2025 census (PA): F and G blocks 10–15% Jan–Sep falling to 7–9% by Dec; one baiting round F and G, two in P18; P18 infestation called extensive. Barn owls: Timur 22 of 36 boxes occupied = 61% (was 58%), P03C 29%, P98A1 and P02B3 50%; Kema 23 of 27 = 85%; box ratios 1:11 and 1:14 (Agro Table 11, Oct 2025 census). PA Timur wrongly says 80%. Ganoderma: PA Timur sporadic at P98A1 (fruiting bodies, upper stem rot), census to start if it spreads; PA Kema many infected palms especially block G, mostly upper stem rot, census and deboling advised; Agro 4.5.7 says negligible. Bagworm: none significant (Agro 4.5.8). Elephants: PA Kema many palms damaged at P18H, once a year, suggests boundary trenches; Agro 5.4: infestation decreasing since early 2026, damaged palms recovering with promising bunches.

PRUNING AND CANOPY (PA, Agro). Timur: 385.18 ha programmed, progressive pruning done 4,528.77 of 4,622.16 ha = 98%, P98A1 89.1%; cost per palm per year RM1.00 (1998), RM0.80 (2002–2003), RM0.75 (2006). Kema: 4,666.75 of 4,874.28 ha = 96% (some pruning quality to be corrected); RM1.00 (1998), RM0.75 (2008, 2009, 2018). Agro: acceptable in both divisions; P18H over/under-pruning minimal. Thinning (Agro 4.2.4, Table 8): 730 palms removed Mar 2025–Apr 2026 in P08G, P09F, P98E (P08G1 271, P08G2 111, P08G3 193, P09F2 40, P98E1 58, P98E2 57), 10–15 ft radius, etiolated palms; table prints grand total 1,748. Removals need Senior Manager approval. Palm condition: mild potassium deficiency in P08G3 and P03C; 2025 leaf sampling showed suboptimal N in P02B2, P02B3, P03C, P06D1, P06D2, P08G3; re-sampling in 2026. P18H mild K and Mg deficiency.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA). Timur: no road grading in 2025 against 1,000 chains budgeted (contractor tied up at Kema, rain); grading and backhoe rental suspended due to diesel price; crusher run 100 of 100 mt at RM50/mt (budget RM41); backhoe 589 hours; eroded culverts at P03C cut the shortcut road; no drain desilting (volume too small to mobilise excavator). Kema: 344.18 of 2,000 chains graded at RM10/chain, none to May 2026; crusher run 233.74 of 375 mt at RM47 (budget RM39); collection roads unsatisfactory, hilly sections badly damaged, main roads laterited; no desilting of 400 chains budgeted. Agro 4.1.3 calls roads generally satisfactory.

HARVESTING AND COLLECTION (PA, Agro). 24 rounds achieved in 2025 vs 24 budget in both divisions. PA interval averaged 12 days; Agro Tables 6–7 show 13–15 days Timur and 11–17 days Kema for Jan–Apr 2026, eight rounds (100% of target) in every block to April. Outturn Timur 104%, Kema 115% (includes Sundays and holidays). Over-ripe bunches and loose fruit negligible (Agro). Wheelbarrows with one cutter and one collector. Rates and output (t/man-day): Timur 1998 RM50/t 1.84; 2002 RM37 1.98; 2003 RM37 1.99; 2006 RM32 2.03 (RM64.98/day, below basic wage RM65.39; 107 bunches in about 6 hours vs 159 potential over 9). Kema 1998 RM47 1.90; 2009 RM38 2.05; 2008 RM38 1.72 (below basic wage); 2018 RM62 1.23. Harvesting cost 2025 Timur RM1,091,538.03 = RM103.83/t vs RM101.30 (harvesting labour 44.47, internal transport 22.69, external transport 31.66, incentive 5.00); Kema RM825,227.28 = RM76.57/t vs RM80.72 (labour 51.18, internal transport 22.83, incentive 2.56; excludes despatch).

CROP (PA, Agro). 2025: Timur FFB 10,513.05 t vs budget 10,295 t on 411.80 ha = 25.53 t/ha (budget 25.00, 2024 24.83 per Agro); CPO 1,973.29 t, OER 18.77% vs 19.00%; kernel 598.19 t, 5.69%. Kema FFB 10,777.97 t vs budget 10,317 t; 26.12 t/ha on 412.70 ha (Agro, +8.3% on 24.11) or 26.53 t/ha on 406.19 ha (PA, budget 25.40, 2024 24.50); CPO 2,023.02 t. Estate 2025 (derived) 21,291.02 t, 25.82 t/ha vs budget 25.00 (20,612 t), 2024 24.47 t/ha (20,175.98 t). Timur crop 2024 was 10,225.67 t; Agro Appendix 2a misprints annual totals for 2021–2024. Monthly FFB Jan–Apr 2026 (Agro App. 2a/2b): Timur 813.68, 547.75, 704.80, 741.28 = 2,807.51 t; Kema 934.06, 635.14, 650.58, 615.00 = 2,834.78 t. Jan–Apr 2025: Timur 2,825.94 t; Kema 3,040.43 t. Jan–Apr 2026 yield Timur 6.82 vs 6.86 t/ha (-0.6%); Kema 6.87 vs 7.37 (-6.8%); estate (derived) 6.84 vs 7.12. Crop losses minimal. Both PAs: palms in a low-cropping season at the June 2026 visits, many without bunches; 2026 yield may miss budget (PA Timur: May 2026 yield 1–2 t/ha below May 2025).
Block 2025 yields (Agro Table 12) range 22.36 (P98A1) to 30.17 t/ha (P08G1); Timur 25.53 (2024 24.83), Kema 26.12 (24.11). All blocks above 20 t/ha; 80% above 24 t/ha.
Yield Jan–Apr 2025 to Jan–Apr 2026 t/ha (Agro Table 13): Timur P02B1 8.10 to 7.29; P02B2 5.84 to 6.77; P06D1 7.03 to 6.43; P06D2 7.83 to 6.81; P98A1 4.71 to 6.94; P02B3 6.22 to 7.14; P03C 7.29 to 6.54. Kema P98E1 5.98 to 7.47; P98E2 7.24 to 6.94; P08G1 7.10 to 6.07; P08G2 7.45 to 6.64; P08G3 8.09 to 7.54; P09F1 7.31 to 7.19; P09F2 8.24 to 7.11; P18H 5.81 to 4.20.
Bunch weight Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 (PA): Timur 1998 fell 25 to 24.7 kg, others rose (2003 19 to 21.3); Kema 1998 fell 33 to 30 kg, 2008/2009/2018 unchanged.

COST OF PRODUCTION (PA, Jan–Dec 2025, RM per tonne FFB). Timur: general charges 171.00 (budget 47.00), upkeep 68.00 (67.00), harvesting 72.00 (71.00; excludes external transport), total 311.00 vs 185.00; per tonne CPO 1,659 vs 953. Kema: general 96.36 (55.46), upkeep 89.43 (70.63), harvesting 108.21 (110.72), total 294.00 vs 236.82; per tonne CPO 1,566.35 vs 1,246.40. PAs blame unbudgeted Head Office general charges (and Kema upkeep anomalies). Combined crop-weighted (derived): general 133.21 (budget 51.07), upkeep 78.94 (68.58), harvest 90.33 (90.88), total 302.48 vs 210.53; the harvest basis differs between divisions.

RAINFALL (PA and Agro appendices). Timur mm (rain days): 2021 3,106 (154); 2022 3,097 (188); 2023 2,962 (158); 2024 2,315 (150); 2025 2,570 (165); Jan–Apr 2026 446 (35). Kema: 2021 2,558 (152); 2022 2,902 (157); 2023 2,541 (138); 2024 2,532 (157); 2025 2,735.5 (142); Jan–Apr 2026 390 (26). Nov–Dec 2025 very wet and disrupted spraying and road grading.

CONCLUSIONS. PA Timur: well managed; recruit harvesters and sprayers, review piece rates, start road grading. PA Kema: crop budget achieved, fields clean; raise circle-spraying productivity, recruit harvesters, finish roads by September. Agro: rat control in P18H urgent; update Kema palm census; supervise thinning.

KNOWN INCONSISTENCIES (see issues list): Ganoderma extent; PA Timur 19.77 t/ha 2024 base and 29% gain; Appendix 2a totals; Kema 406.19 vs 412.70 ha; weeding completion; rat status; roads; replanting plans; barn owl 80% vs 61%; COP basis; Timur labour table; thinning total; harvest interval.

costDetail.src: PA Report 1/2026 Timur A & B (sections 5–9) + PA Report 1/2026 Kema Division (sections 5–9); combined by summing RM amounts / combined FFB
notes: Combined Timur A&B (Accent Palms + Promvest, 411.80 ha) and Kema (406.19 ha): all items are calc:true = summed reported RM amounts of both PA reports divided by combined FFB (actual 10,513.05 + 10,777.97 = 21,291.02 t; budget 10,295 + 10,317 = 20,612 t). Period 'to date' = Jan–Dec 2025.

Upkeep: summed RM amounts of both divisions; zero/empty lines omitted. Timur General Charges sum of Accent Palms (RM1,194,118.43) + Promvest (RM603,436.05); Kema RM1,038,551.86; sub-items add to those totals.
General charges combined 133.21 and upkeep 78.94 match dashboard costParts (budget 51.07 and 68.58 also match).

HARVEST MISMATCH vs dashboard (90.33 / budget 90.88): the two reports treat external transport (FFB despatch) differently in Production Cost table 9. Timur table 9 prints 72 (RM/t, integer-rounded, excludes external transport; section 7 total with external transport is 103.83 = RM1,091,538.03). Kema table 9 prints 108.21 (includes despatch; section 7 total excl. despatch is 76.57 = RM825,227.28). Dashboard figure 90.33 appears to average 72 and 108.21 on mixed bases. Here both are put on the including-external-transport basis (consistent with Kema table 9 and Timur section 7), giving 106.05 actual / 106.01 budget (dashboard budget 90.88).

Kema external transport RM amount is not printed: derived from printed table 9 RM/t less section 7 RM/t (108.21 - 76.57 = 31.64 actual; 110.72 - 80.72 = 30.00 budget) times Kema FFB, so small rounding error (about +/-RM100). Kema's 30.00 budget equals Timur's 30.00 budget for external transport, supporting the derivation.
Timur Table 9 prints group figures rounded to whole numbers (171/68/72, budget 47/67/71 = total 311/185) and 1,659 RM/t CPO; the section 5-7 amounts reproduce 171.00 (general) and 68.18 (upkeep).
Total (sum of groups) will differ from dashboard kpi.cop 302.48 because of the harvest basis above.
Total 318.20 actual / 225.66 budget (sum of combined groups) vs dashboard 302.48.
